question: Which of the following is not a surrounding feature of the Thar Desert?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vindhya Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Thar Desert, also known as the Great Indian Desert, is primarily located in the northwestern part of India and southeastern Pakistan.
 
• Surrounding features of the Thar Desert include the Aravalli Range, Rann of Kachchh, and the Indus River Plain.
 
• The Vindhya Hills are geographically situated farther south and do not form part of the surrounding features of the Thar Desert.
 
• The Thar Desert is bordered by the Rann of Kachchh in Gujarat to the southwest and the Aravalli Range to the southeast.
 
• The Indus River Plain lies to the west of the Thar Desert and forms part of its broader geographical context.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thar Desert Geography:**

 
 
• The Thar Desert spans approximately 200,000 square kilometers and covers parts of Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana in India.
 
• It is characterized by sandy terrain, dunes, sparse vegetation, and extreme temperature variations.
 
 
 
• **Aravalli Range:**
 
 
• The Aravalli Range is one of the oldest mountain ranges in India and acts as a natural barrier between the Thar Desert and the fertile regions of eastern Rajasthan.
 
• It plays a significant role in influencing the climate and ecology of the Thar Desert.
 
 
 
• **Rann of Kachchh:**
 
 
• Located in Gujarat, the Rann of Kachchh is a salt marsh and forms the southwestern boundary of the Thar Desert.
 
• It is known for its unique ecosystem and the famous Rann Utsav cultural festival.
 
 
 
• **Vindhya Hills:**
 
 
• The Vindhya Hills are located in central India and are considered a geographical divide between northern and southern India.
 
• They do not have a direct connection to the Thar Desert's geographical features.
 
 
 
• **Indus River Plain:**
 
 
• The Indus River Plain lies to the west of the Thar Desert and is part of the broader drainage system of the region.
 
• This plain is fertile and contrasts with the arid conditions of the Thar Desert.
